title: Greek Cucumber Garlic Yoghurt Dip
summary: A cool, creamy cucumber dip with garlic and dill, inspired by classic Greek tzatziki. Fresh, tangy, and perfect with pita, crackers, or crisp vegetables as a snack.
steps: Grate the cucumber, then squeeze it well in a clean cloth or with your hands to remove as much liquid as possible.
Finely grate or crush the garlic and chop the dill.
In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, cucumber, garlic, dill, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper until evenly combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed, then chill for 5 minutes before serving for the best flavour.
Serve cold with pita, crackers, or sliced vegetables.
